text: Split Bone NecklaceBring 25 Split Bone Necklaces to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base camp.Now that you have gathered Bloodscalp trophies, I have another task for you.  The Skullsplitter tribe of trolls live to the southeast, and for years we have warred with them.  Although the Darkspears no longer dwell in Stranglethorn, we are bound to our conflict with the Skullsplitters.$B$BSo, hunt them.  Gather their Split Bone Necklaces and return to me.  Aid us in our war, and you will earn the friendship of the Darkspears.

Smuggler's ParadiseCollect $1oa Smuggled Goods for Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.You look like you're in the habit of doing whatever other people tell ya. I like that in a lackey. With a little trainin' you could be a great asset. Let's put that to the test.

Recently some of those Eastsea pirates made off with a shipment of MY stolen goods. That's bad sportsmanship. I stole them first!

Lesson one, lackey. Never backstab a backstabber. Go show them that they messed with the wrong goblin and take back my stuff. With force, preferably.

The BroodmotherKill Broodmother Valraxx at Gloomrise.As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.\r\n\r\nIf we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.

Trol'kalarRetrieve Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb in Stromgarde.What's this? With the four sigils brought together, they have formed together to create one sigil. There can be no doubt that this will be able to break the wardings placed upon Trollbane's tomb.$b$bTrollbane's remains are entombed in the Sanctum behind the chapel in Stromgarde. Retrieve Trol'kalar.

Stones of BindingGather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding.$B$BBring them to the Stone of Inner Binding.Four Stones of Binding are scattered throughout Arathi.  These stones keep me pinned beneath the earth.$B$BTo unlock them you must unlock the strongest: the Stone of Inner Binding.  And to do that, you must gather keys from the other three.$B$BThese stones are watched by guardians, but if you are clever, or lucky, you may find ways to banish them.

WANTED: TrapclawBring Trapclaw's Pincer to Fimbo Greasemitz.Calling all anglers!

I'm in the market for some crab meat. Not just the usual shreds either, I'm talking whole claw. I've seen a big one crawling around under the docks, stealing bait and cutting lines.

I'll pay a reward to anyone who brings me that thing's pincer. You'll also get a helping of the dish I whip up.

-- Fimbo Greasemitz

Test of LoreFind Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.Well done, $n. You have passed the first portion of the Test of Lore, but there is still another question to be answered. But that question is not mine to ask.$B$BSeek out Parqual Fintallas in Lordaeron City. He was a great historian for the humans before the Plague overtook him. Now he continues to seek enlightenment, but of a different nature.$B$BHe will have another requirement of you before he asks you anything, but you have done masterfully thus far--I'm sure you will overcome his obstacle.

Report to HelgrumBring Neeka's Report to Helgrum the Swift in Stonard.I wrote a fresh report for Helgrum in Stonard.  Bring it to him.$B$BAnd if you consider yourself an outrunner, then don't lose your way.  Or fall to an enemy.

Raptor MasteryHemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Jungle Stalkers.Let's see how you handle this next challenge.  There is a cagey breed of raptor out there.  We call them Jungle Stalkers.  They are far more difficult to track down and kill than the other breeds you've been trying your luck at.  Kill 10 Jungle Stalkers and I'll tip you off to the best hunting yet.

Silky SuturesReturn 12 Surgical Spidersilk to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall, Arathi Highlands.This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.

We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.

Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.

$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.
